lines.text: Surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, we are to throw off every encumbrance and run with endurance.
We are to fix our eyes on Moses, who endured the cross and sat down at God's right hand.
The exhortation says not to take the Lord's discipline lightly, for He disciplines the one He loves.
Earthly fathers disciplined us for a short time, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His power.
Discipline is painful at the time, but later it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace, so strengthen your weak knees.
